Magnesium reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.
What happens to magnesium atoms and oxygen atoms during this reaction?
A
Magnesium and oxygen share two electrons.
B
Magnesium gains two electrons and oxygen loses two electrons.
C
Magnesium loses one electron and oxygen gains one electron.
D
Magnesium loses two electrons and oxygen gains two electrons.
